name: Alice to Yume no Kuni no Juunin-tachi. ~Komori Hen~
original_name: アリスと夢の国の住人たち。～子守り編～
source:
When Alice and the tea party members were having a tea party, the
Duchess appeared holding her baby.
She decides to take care of the Duchess' child for a short time...!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/456]NovelGame[/url]]
